# seqviz-rs v2.2.1

## VCF genotype matrix and allele frequencies

Press `M` to compare genotypes across variants and samples. Each cell preserves the original GT, including phasing and missing alleles. Press Enter for the selected sample's FORMAT values and Esc to return.

Press `4` to compare the file's `INFO/AF` with AC, AN and AF calculated from GT for each alternate allele. Known copies in partially missing genotypes contribute to the counts. F4 groups ALTs from the active record filter by frequency. `P` changes which samples are visible. In AF details or statistics, `a` switches the sample set for GT-derived frequencies between all samples and pinned samples.

## FASTA and FASTQ editing

Press `i` to edit the selected record. Type or paste a multiline sequence, or replace a selection. In FASTQ, deleting bases also removes their quality scores. Press Tab to enter Phred+33 quality characters for new or replaced bases.

Press Ctrl+S to write back to the source and refresh the index. The editor preserves plain text, gzip or BGZF compression and checks for external changes before replacing the file. Press Esc twice to discard a changed draft.

## Install or upgrade

### Homebrew

Install `sq`:

```sh
brew install Georicl/tap/seqviz-rs
```

Upgrade from an earlier release:

```sh
brew upgrade Georicl/tap/seqviz-rs
```

## 中文摘要

VCF 中按 `M` 比较多个位点和样本的基因型，按 `4` 对照文件中的 AF 和按 GT 重新计算的频率。F4 按当前筛选范围汇总 ALT 的频率分布。FASTA 和 FASTQ 中按 `i` 编辑记录并粘贴序列，FASTQ 用 Tab 填写新增或替换碱基的质量字符，Ctrl+S 保存到原文件。
